issues.on_page: Bonds Retired (20,000) under Other Financing Sources (Uses), Total column
issues.issue: Bonds Retired (20,000) is a bond principal payment, but it was put into other_financing. Under the outside_printed_total rule (loan payments printed below the total), it should be a disbursements item (debt service principal, outside_printed_total: true), and other_financing should be the remainder. Warrants Retired (32,326) is the same kind of debt repayment (see warning on detail). The computed sum is right (-20,000 - 32,326 - 24,826 = -77,152) and the identity holds.

Warrants Retired lines (detail[12], detail[26]) are the same.
